messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty triggered PD-7891 for embeddings-eu — 5xx rate spiked to ~18% over 2m. Auto-bridge created: https://meet.company/bridges/PD-7891. Paging rota shows sam as primary.
incident-bot: Incident INC-7891 created and linked to PD-7891. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/embeddings-queue-runbook.
maria: acked. i'm on it — looking at queue metrics and recent deploys. pinging infra for pool capacity.
sam: on call but handing to maria, she has the deepest context. thanks :pray: maria, any quick customer-impact summary?
maria: early notes — embeddings endpoint returning 500 for requests > 512 tokens, errors start around 02:13 UTC. traffic increased due to a batch import job from partner X. some customers getting timeouts/fails, roughly 10-15% of active requests.
alex: tag customer success: @cs-team — might need to pre-emptively message top customers. also if we need to throttle batch imports that's an easy temporary mitigation.
maria: plan: 1) scale embeddings-eu dedicated pool +2 GPUs; 2) enable degraded-model fallback (lower-memory variant) for requests >1k tokens; 3) rate-limit the heavy import job. attempting scale now.
maria: ```
# scale command
./infra/ctl scale --pool embeddings-eu --delta 2 --reason "PD-7891 spike"
# or via k8s
kubectl -n inference scale deployment embeddings-eu-worker --replicas=6
```
jonah: if we scale, watch KV cache warm-up — may see short latency spike as workers spin up. i'll watch cache hit rates.
incident-bot: Autoscale triggered: scaling request accepted, estimated time to capacity: ~90s. Alerting on new errors suppressed for 5m.
maria: scaled +2 GPUs confirmed (instances: gpu-12,gpu-13). seeing immediate drop in 5xx to ~7% but  latency for 1-2 requests spiked for warm-up.
sam: good. maria please assign a short customer impact note for the ticket so CS can post. also leave a TODO in the runbook for batch import throttling.
maria: added to INC-7891: "Partial failure for embeddings export jobs causing ~10% user-facing 500s between 02:13-02:22 UTC, mitigated by scaling and rate-limiting partner import. Investigating root cause — likely resource exhaustion on large token batches."
alex: thumbs up. can we keep degraded fallback active for 30m and monitor? set a rollback if quality drop > X.
maria: fallback on for requests >1k tokens; monitoring thresholds set. dashboards updated.
jonah: i'll keep an eye and plan to take over at 03:30 UTC if issues persist — ping me for handoff.
sam: noted. maria, if you need a formal handoff before you step down, post a quick status and next steps.
maria: quick status for handoff: scaled +2 GPUs, degraded-model fallback enabled, partner import throttled to 20r/s. Current 5xx at 3-6%. Monitoring for 15m. Next oncall jonah at 03:30 UTC to take ownership if stable.
jonah: ack — i'll join the bridge at 03:28 UTC and take over if still active.
incident-bot: PD-7891 marked acknowledged by maria. Next escalation remains sam if no ack in 10m.
alex: also recommend we add a planned follow-up: add a protective pre-filter on large batch jobs to avoid saturating single pool. cc: infra and product.
maria: noted, creating ticket PBI-1422 for long-term fix.
sam: great work team. leaving this thread open for jonah handoff. :thumbsup:
jonah: joining bridge now to confirm metrics and brief.
summary: PagerDuty PD-7891 fired for embeddings-eu high 5xx. Maria acknowledged, scaled dedicated pool +2 GPUs, enabled degraded-model fallback, throttled partner import. Error rate dropped from ~18% to 3-6%. Jonah to take over at 03:30 UTC if still active. Incident INC-7891 created; follow-up ticket PBI-1422 opened.
